title: Mirror Walk
reference: F1(9) F1(9) def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward if tile_is r { turn_left } F1 if tile_is r { turn_right } forward } }
hints: Going out, turn left on red. Coming back, the same red tile needs the mirror turn: right.
F1: if wall ahead, turn left twice, else forward, if red turn left, F1, if red turn right, forward. Main: F1(9), F1(9).
F1(9) F1(9) def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward if tile_is r { turn_left } F1 if tile_is r { turn_right } forward } }

story.intro: PATCH: "On the way back everything happens in reverse. A left turn going out is a right turn coming home."
